newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila court to hear plea to allow Ramos 2nd term.
newsitem.headline: Manila court to hear plea to allow Ramos 2nd term.

text.p: The Philippine Supreme Court decided on Tuesday to hear a citizens group's case for an amendment to the constitution to allow President Fidel Ramos to run for a second term.
People's Initiative for Reform, Modernisation and Action (PIRMA) filed a petition with more than 5.5 million signatures from people saying they wanted the constitution amended.
Documents showed the court had called on those opposed to PIRMA to comment on the petition within 10 days.
The move for an amendment of the constitution has been a divisive issue in the country. Those opposed to any change say it was engineered by Ramos so that he could stay on in power.
Ramos, whose terms ends in June next year, has repeatedly said he will not stand for election again but his critics have doubted him.
